transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we all know, the current chair of our employee resource group is stepping down after this program cycle, so we need to start planning for the leadership transition. I have the authority to approve the group's next leadership charter and participation practices, but before I can sign off on anything, the process requires a consultation with the outgoing chair and deputy chair. I'd like to use this time to start discussing what we want the next charter to look like, especially considering our monthly live sessions and the members who participate remotely. Who'd like to kick things off?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Elena. As the outgoing chair, I'm happy to kick things off. I think it's important that our next charter addresses both the leadership structure and how we keep our remote members engaged during the monthly live sessions. One thing I'd like to put on the table is the idea of a transition term for the next chair — a defined period where the new chair can get up to speed with support from the outgoing leadership. I have some thoughts on that, but I'd also love to hear from others about what they'd like to see in the new charter before we finalize anything.
